definitions.archive_percent: 100 * median compressed bytes / input bytes; smaller is denser
definitions.local_front: recomputed within a fixed five-percentage-point band; may be globally dominated
definitions.nearest: absolute byte gap, then greater D, then smaller archive, then canonical identifier
definitions.rounds: three external byte-verified roundtrips; component-wise medians before rounding
definitions.strict_C: strictly fewer compressed bytes AND strictly greater median C MB/s
definitions.strict_D: strictly fewer compressed bytes AND strictly greater median D MB/s
